mechanism: JPX weekly cash-equity foreign investor net trading value in the common Tokyo & Nagoya aggregate sheet; sibling but distinct from OSE Nikkei 225 mini futures trading flow.
literature_basis: Kamesaka, Nofsinger & Kawakita (2003): foreign investors in Japan showed favorable market timing in weekly aggregate trading.
Bae, Yamada & Ito: foreign investors generated gains from good market timing in Japan.
Iwatsubo & Watkins (2021): foreign investors have information advantages in Tokyo price formation.

source.publisher: Japan Exchange Group / Tokyo Stock Exchange
source.dataset: Trading by Type of Investors - Equities - Weekly - Value

pit.publication_rule: Approximately 15:30 JST on the fourth JPX business day of the following week
pit.irregular_week_rule: Same fail-closed rule as foreign-flow PIT v1: if following week has fewer than four regular business days, exclude
pit.earliest_use: Next regular Nikkei trading day after publication

return_window.entry: first Nikkei close on or after earliest-use date
return_window.exit: close exactly five trading sessions after entry

all_required: at least 3 of 4 frozen chronological subperiods positive

forbidden: Open a third foreign-flow sibling family after this test
next_action: Build and pass source/PIT Data Gate before any return merge.
